concerns.text: T016 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T012 (HumanEval download) to access the dataset. A task that consumes an artifact (the dataset) cannot run in parallel with the task that produces it (T012). The [P] tag is incorrect and creates a hidden ordering violation.

T017 is marked [P] but depends on T013, T014, T015 (perturbation functions) AND T016 (semantic validator). The description states 'Dependency: T013, T014, T015, T016'. Since T016 is a prerequisite, T017 cannot be parallel-safe relative to the validator implementation. The [P] tag is misleading.

T034 (Sensitivity Analysis) depends on T017 (Generation) to access the raw candidate pool (`data/processed/perturbation_candidates_raw.json`). The task description lists 'Dependency: Phase 4 (T021...), T017'. However, T034 is marked [P] in the 'Parallel Opportunities' section. While T034 can run in parallel with T032/T033/T035 *after* T017/T021 are done, the [P] tag on the task itself implies it has no dependencies, which is false. It must strictly follow T017 and T021.

T038 (ECE Calculation) depends on T021 (Inference) to access `avg_confidence` scores. The task lists 'Dependency: Phase 4 (T021...)'. However, T038 is grouped in Phase 5 with other [P] tasks. If T038 is attempted before T021 completes, it will fail. The [P] tag on T038 is incorrect as it has a hard data dependency on T021.

The 'Parallel Opportunities' section states 'T032, T033, T034, T035, T036, T038 all depend on the completion of Phase 4'. However, T036 (Final Report) depends on T032-T038. T036 cannot be parallel with T032-T038; it must be the final step in the chain. The grouping implies T036 can run in parallel with the analysis tasks, which is a logical impossibility.
